- **Dimensions & Code Run:** Minimum **`24 in.` continuous solid wood walkway** with **`30 in.` unobstructed passageway clearance** from hatch to furnace service side; **`≤ 20 ft` max run** (Unit 4 attic height is confirmed `66 in.` `< 6 ft`).
- **Cheapest Compliant Wood Options:**
  1. **23/32" (3/4" nominal) rated OSB sheathing** *(cheapest compliant option)*
  2. **3/4" rated structural plywood** *(R5 p. 7 option)*
  3. **Solid 2× framing lumber**
  *(NEVER use 3/8" plywood!)*
- **Saw-Kerf Sheet Math:** Count **ONE true 24"-wide strip per 4×8 sheet** (saw kerf eats ~1/8" off a 48" sheet: `L ≤ 7 ft` -> 1 sheet, `7–14 ft` -> 2 sheets, `14–20 ft` -> 3 sheets).
- **Fastening & Support:** Screw with **`#9 × 2-1/2"` or `3"` structural/deck wood screws** into verified joists/supports (NEVER nails, NEVER drywall screws, NEVER resting on ceiling drywall, insulation, wires, or pipes).

### ENGLISH — STEP 5 (30" × 30" SERVICE PLATFORM & NEXT SCOPE SPLIT)
- **Wiki Plan & R5:** [Attic Access](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/#attic-access) · [HVAC Attic Opening Plan](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-opening-plan.html) · [R5 EN PDF (p. 7)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf) · [Guía R5 ES PDF (pág. 7)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_ES.pdf)
- **Requirement:** Build a **`30 × 30 in.` minimum level solid working platform** on the service side of the furnace (`23/32"` rated OSB or `3/4"` structural plywood screwed to verified framing with `#9 × 2-1/2"` or `3"` wood screws; never resting on drywall).
- **No Vibration Pads Needed from John:** NEXT handles furnace installation and equipment isolation — John does **NOT** need to supply or install vibration pads.
- **B-Vent Clearance:** Coordinate furnace spot so Type B double-wall flue maintains **`≥ 1 in.` clearance to combustibles**.

---

### ESPAÑOL — PASO 5 (PLATAFORMA DE SERVICIO 30" × 30" Y ALCANCE CON NEXT)
- **Wiki, Plan y R5:** [Attic Access / Acceso al Ático](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/#attic-access) · [Plan de Apertura al Ático](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-opening-plan.html) · [Guía R5 ES PDF (pág. 7)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_ES.pdf) · [R5 EN PDF (p. 7)](https://tisa-a11y.github.io/unit4-wiki-pages/wiki-docs/attic-hatch-r5/Attic-hatch-practical-guide_R5_EN.pdf)
- **Requisito:** Construir una **plataforma sólida y nivelada mínima de `30 × 30 pulg.`** frente al lado de servicio del calefactor (`OSB clasificado de 23/32"` o `triplay estructural de 3/4"` atornillado con `#9 × 2-1/2"` o `3"` a apoyos estructurales; nunca sobre tablaroca).
- **Sin almohadillas antivibración:** NEXT realiza la instalación del calefactor; John **NO** necesita comprar ni colocar almohadillas antivibración.
- **Tiro Tipo B:** Respetar **`≥ 1 pulg.` de separación libre** respecto a madera/materiales combustibles.
